soda-jam.title: Soda Jam: Color Sort
soda-jam.short: Sort juicy fruit soda cans, clear stacks, and solve color puzzles.
soda-jam.desc:
Soda Jam: Color Sort is a relaxing soda sort puzzle game where you sort and match colorful fruit soda flavors into the right tubes.

Give your body and soul a calm place to rest with a light, sparkling color sort experience. Move the juicy fruit blocks, match the same color, clear stacks, and beat each level with smart strategic moves.

The gameplay is easy to learn, but every puzzle will test your logic, focus, and planning as more colors, tubes, and stacks appear. Arrange all colors, organize each tube, and enjoy satisfying fill-and-clear moments at your own pace, with no speed pressure or timer.

Inspired by classic water sort and liquid sorting puzzle games, Soda Jam gives you a fresh soda-themed twist on color sorting gameplay. Each level brings a small spark of challenge, with bright soda colors, juicy fruits, fizzy flavors, refreshing beverages, and fun tube puzzle action.

Plan each move carefully: one tube, one color when complete. Use logic, careful thinking, and a little strategy to turn a messy stack into a perfectly organized tube, and let every soda flavor find its perfect place.

At its heart, Soda Jam is a casual color sorting puzzle for anyone who loves to relax and unwind with a clever brain teaser. There is real satisfaction in matching colors and watching each tube fall into place — a colorful world of puzzles and light brain training for focus, logic, and a quick mental refresh.

Tap to move blocks, plan each step, use undo or restart when needed, unlock helpful boosters and hints, and solve every soda jam before the tubes get full. With smooth, gradual difficulty across many levels, each stage stays simple to understand and satisfying to master.

gridsmash.title: Color Block Puzzle Master
gridsmash.short: Relaxing block puzzle game. Clear lines, blast blocks, play offline.
gridsmash.desc:
Color Block Puzzle Master is a relaxing block puzzle game where every move matters.

Drag and drop colorful blocks onto an 8x8 board, clear full rows and columns, make smart combos, and keep playing offline with no timer or pressure. It is simple to learn, satisfying to play, and challenging to master.

HOW TO PLAY

Place blocks on the board and try to complete full lines. Clear rows and columns to open more space, plan your next move carefully, and keep the board from filling up.

Every piece matters. A smart move can create space, trigger a combo, or save your game when the board gets tight. When no more blocks fit, the round is over.

RELAXING COLOR BLOCK PUZZLE GAME

Enjoy a calm color block puzzle experience designed for quick breaks, relaxing sessions, and daily brain challenges.

There is no timer, no rush, and no stressful countdown. Play at your own pace, focus on the board, and enjoy smooth controls with satisfying line clears.

MAKE COMBOS AND BLAST BLOCKS

Clear multiple lines in one move to create combos and earn higher scores. Think ahead, manage your space, and look for the best position for every block.

When the board is almost full, use the bomb power-up to blast blocks, clear a 3x3 area, and open new space. A well-timed blast can keep your run alive and help you reach a better score.

26 UNIQUE BLOCK SHAPES

Color Block Puzzle Master includes 26 different block shapes, from simple squares to tricky L-shapes. Each shape adds a new puzzle decision and makes every round feel different.

As the board fills up, the strategy becomes deeper. Plan carefully, create space, and become a true puzzle master.

GAME FEATURES

* Classic block puzzle gameplay
* Relaxing color block puzzle experience
* Easy drag-and-drop controls
* 8x8 board with rows and columns to clear
* No timer and no pressure
* Play offline with no wifi needed
* Smart combos for higher scores
* Bomb power-up to blast blocks and clear space
* 26 unique block shapes
* Smooth controls and satisfying clears
* Quick sessions for short breaks
* Challenging rounds for puzzle lovers
* Brain game experience for logic and planning
* Google Play Games leaderboard support

If you enjoy block puzzle games, color block games, block blast puzzle games, blast puzzle games, logic puzzles, brain games, or relaxing casual games, Color Block Puzzle Master gives you a clean and satisfying puzzle experience.

word-slot.title: Word Slot: Fill-In Crossword
word-slot.short: Fill-in word puzzles: slot blocks into a crossword grid. No timer, no losing.
word-slot.desc:
Word Slot is a calm fill-in crossword puzzle for people who like to think without a clock running.

Every stage hands you a crossword grid that has been cut into letter blocks and scattered around the board. Your job is to slot each block back into the word grid so that every row and every column reads as a real word. Easy to pick up, and genuinely hard by the end.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
The board never tells you whether a block is in the right place. It only shows you what the letters currently spell. There are no green ticks and no red crosses to lean on, so you confirm the answer by reading it yourself. When a stage finally clicks, the deduction was yours.

NO TIMER. NO LIVES. NO WAY TO LOSE.
This is a relaxing word game, not a race. Nothing counts down and nothing runs out. You can put a board away mid-thought and pick it up later. The only score is a 1-3 star rating for how cleanly you rebuilt the grid, and most boards can be solved more than one way.

392 HAND-BUILT STAGES
A full campaign of 392 word puzzles, hand-made rather than generated. It opens with gentle 3x3 grids and builds to dense 18x9 finales. The difficulty is deliberately shaped, so a hard stage is followed by room to breathe instead of a straight climb.

FEATURES
* 392 fill-in crossword stages, from 3x3 to 18x9 word grids
* No timer, no lives, no fail state: a calm puzzle game at your own pace
* 1-3 stars per stage, based on how few blocks you misplaced
* Multiple valid solutions on most boards
* Five optional power-ups: Check, Sweep, Anchor, Ghost Line, Blueprint
* Coins from clears and stars, plus a daily reward chest
* Weekly and all-time leaderboards: pick a nickname, no account needed
* Cloud save, dark mode and haptics
* Optional reminder notification, off unless you turn it on
* Free to play, single player

POWER-UPS THAT STAY OPTIONAL
Check, Sweep, Anchor, Ghost Line and Blueprint are bought with coins you earn by playing. They are there for the stage that will not budge. Never required, and never in the way of solving it yourself.

PLAY ANONYMOUSLY
Word Slot starts the moment you open it. No sign-up, no account, no email. Google sign-in is there only if you want to carry your progress to a new phone.

FOR PUZZLE PEOPLE
If you like crossword puzzles, word fit and fill-in puzzles, word blocks, or a good logic puzzle, this is built for you. A word puzzle game for adults who want something to actually solve.

Free, with ads. Optional rewarded video if you want extra coins.
